title: Highwayman
name: Dismas
description: The Highwayman is an escaped convict and a robber by trade, who takes work wherever it pays and trusts few of the people he works beside. Prison and life on the run have taught him to expect the worst, and he jokes freely about the noose still waiting for him. He has taken a contract to guard the Heirs to the Estate, and means to make more of it than a job: a chance to become a better man than the robber he was.
history: The Highwayman escaped prison during a riot, and with a garrison on his heels went to ground in the city's canals. Freedom there meant filth and hunger, and a diet that came to include the rats he lived among. Sick and starving, he took an advance of gold from an unscrupulous employer for one final heist: a stagecoach robbery. When the shooting stopped, he found a woman and her child dead inside, killed by stray gunfire.
summary: A distrustful escaped convict and robber, running from the gallows and the guilt of a heist that killed a mother and child.

appearance.hairStyle: Short and shaved at the sides
appearance.features: Narrow, stubbled face (lower half hidden by scarf)

clothing.head: Red scarf over the lower face
clothing.body: Dark grey greatcoat with a fur collar, over a brown waistcoat and red neckerchief

notes: Has a gallows sense of humor
Carries a locket taken from a victim and fidgets with it during moments of guilt
Frequently punctuates statements with 'eh' and drops the g's on -ing words
Writes poetry in secret, and labours over the rhymes
